resources.string: %1$s isn\'t working right now, so %2$s is being used instead

Mapbox accepts your token but keeps refusing the map. Sign in at account.mapbox.com and look for a notice about your account.
Mapbox says that isn\'t a whole token: part of it is missing or mistyped. Copy it again with the copy button at account.mapbox.com › Tokens (typing it in by hand rarely works).
Mapbox says that token has a mistake in it. Copy it again with the copy button at account.mapbox.com › Tokens rather than typing it.
Mapbox says that token has been deleted or replaced. Copy one that\'s still listed at account.mapbox.com › Tokens%1$s.
That\'s a temporary token and it has run out. Copy your Default public token (it starts pk.) at account.mapbox.com › Tokens.
Mapbox didn\'t accept your access token (401). Copy it again with the copy button at account.mapbox.com › Tokens.
No voice for directions: install or turn on a text-to-speech engine (Settings > Sound & voice > Voice and language)
The text-to-speech voice has no language installed, so directions can\'t be spoken. Add one in Settings > Sound & voice > Voice and language
%1$s: hold on it to add it as a stop
%1$s: hold on it to go there
Download failed: %1$s. Tap Download again to carry on.
Mapbox won\'t let this token show the map (403). At account.mapbox.com › Tokens, edit it: tick all the public scopes and remove any URL restrictions.
The map couldn\'t make a secure connection. Check the head unit\'s date and time are right.
No signal for the map: trying again…
Add your Mapbox access token (it starts pk.) in Settings > Keys & accounts to show the map
Satellite view needs a connection: showing the downloaded map until it\'s back
TomTom turned down the key for its map, so Mapbox\'s map is showing
Add a TomTom key in Settings > Keys & accounts for TomTom\'s map. Showing Mapbox\'s map
Location permission is needed for navigation
That stretch is too short to avoid
Allow Horizon Nav to install updates, then tap Update again

Couldn\'t reach the download. Check the connection and try again.
No signal, and nothing saved or downloaded matches
No signal. Download the offline pack or place names in Settings > Offline maps to search with no signal
The head unit\'s date and time look wrong. Set them right in its settings: until then, maps, search and routes can\'t connect even with signal.
No signal: showing saved places and offline towns
Search failed: weak or no signal
No matches. Try adding a town or postcode.
Weak signal: showing saved places and offline towns
To plan routes, add a free TomTom key or Mapbox token in Settings > Keys & accounts, or download the offline pack
No GPS fix yet: routing from the map centre. Use the demo drive to simulate.

Couldn\'t make a secure connection. Check the head unit\'s date and time are right, then try again.
